prompt.hint:
I'm teaching myself algorithms from a roadmap; this problem is in the section "{{lesson}}".
I'm working on "{{title}}" on {{site}}: {{url}}

I'm a beginner and don't know how to solve it yet. Coach me like a tutor; don't give me the solution right away:
1. Restate the problem in simple words with one small example. If you're not sure which problem this is, ask me to paste the statement instead of guessing.
2. Give me one small hint at a time, then stop and wait for my reply. Go from brute force to the optimal approach, and name the technique it uses.
3. Only write full code ({{lang}}) when I ask for it.
prompt.explain:
I'm teaching myself algorithms from a roadmap; this problem is in the section "{{lesson}}".
Please explain "{{title}}" on {{site}}: {{url}}

I'm a beginner, so walk me through it step by step:
1. What the problem asks, in simple words, with one small example. If you're not sure which problem this is, ask me to paste the statement instead of guessing.
2. The brute-force approach and why it is too slow.
3. The key observation that leads to the optimal approach, and which technique that is.
4. The algorithm step by step, traced by hand on the example from step 1.
5. {{lang}} code with short comments.
6. Time/space complexity and the edge cases that are easy to get wrong.
